title: Treasury auction strength (bid-to-cover surprise) predicts the next days' returns
data: treasury_auctions.parquet (Fiscal Data, 2009+): 2-, 5-, 10-, 30-year notes/bonds mapped to ZT/ZF/ZN/ZB as in A3
signal: surprise = bid-to-cover minus the median of the previous 8 auctions of the same tenor (known after the 13:00 ET auction, before the close)
rule: from the next session for H days: long the mapped future if surprise > 0, short if < 0; 0.10 / vol (60d) / 4 per root; daily_book costs
judgement: EQR book + entrant; ONE evaluation 2023-26 vs 1.218
